runner: modules/fingerprint-schemes/check_survivability.py (match rows compare observed_result to expected_result; scores recompute with obravera-com/obravera-fingerprint-verifier)
scope: ISCC Content-Code Text similarity at document unit, and at block unit for a subject that is part of a whole
qualification: Proves only that the named decision policy yields the stated result on these fixture bytes. Does not prove derivation, grounding, use in output, ownership, licensing or completeness; a not_found is not evidence of non-use.
